scenario: Bedrock InvokeModel returns ThrottlingException three times in a row, then succeeds.
notes: AGGRESSIVE = 5 attempts, base 200ms, factor 2 -- 3 failures then success stays well inside the attempt/time cap; written FaultRecord is sampled at 1/100 since fault_class=transient_throttling.

scenario: DDB PutItem hits ProvisionedThroughputExceededException once, then succeeds on the single retry.
notes: SINGLE = exactly 1 retry after 200ms fixed, per spec's explicit assignment for this exact exception.

scenario: STS AssumeRole fails with AccessDenied -- not a throttle, must not be retried at all.
notes: NONE policy short-circuits on the first attempt; FaultRecord written 100% (non-transient class, never sampled).

scenario: Bedrock Guardrail intervenes on a specialist's completion.
notes: Guardrail interventions are model-fault, fail-conservative, never retried per spec §3.

scenario: F3's Athena query fails; cached S3 access-log summaries from procedural memory are available.
notes: F3 has a fast path per §5; payload must carry data_source=cached once the fallback lands in the specialist's own output composition (out of this phase's scope -- the dispatcher only proves the fallback fires).

scenario: F5 Session Terminator's slow path fails -- there is no fast-path mirror for an emergency revocation.
notes: F5/F8 are the two specialists with has_fast_path=False; dispatch_with_fallback must raise EscalatedError without ever calling a fast path.

scenario: An F1 turn's SentinelDecisionsInFlight row has started_at 7 minutes in the past with no Bedrock trace activity in the last 3 minutes.
notes: F1 is not in the extended-threshold set (F3/F4 only), so the default 5-minute threshold applies; watchdog writes a synthetic DecisionRecord(status=ESCALATED) and an SNS SentinelStuckSession alert.

scenario: An F4 SCP-impact turn's row has started_at 8 minutes in the past.
notes: F4 gets the extended 10-minute threshold per §10 risk mitigation (long-running history replay is not a false stuck signal); 8 minutes < 10, so the watchdog must NOT rescue it yet.

scenario: SentinelFoundationStack's AuditorReadOnlyPolicy (AWS::IAM::Policy) was manually edited out-of-band.
notes: Matches §8's own worked example ("IAM policy manually edited") -- drift/detector calls UpdateStack with the CDK-synthesized template to reassert desired state.

scenario: SentinelSecurityStack's EvidenceKmsKey (AWS::KMS::Key) key policy was changed out-of-band.
notes: §8 explicitly forbids auto-remediating KMS key policy changes under any condition; drift/detector must page SentinelOps via SNS instead of calling UpdateStack.
